name: CEI 23-50 (Type L, Italian 10 A and 16 A)
description: Italian household plug and socket system with three round pins in a row: line and neutral on either side of a central earth pin. Two sizes exist, 10 A (4 mm pins, 19 mm apart) and 16 A (5 mm pins, 26 mm apart); the unpolarised layout lets the plug enter either way. The 'bipasso' socket-outlet accepts both sizes.

standards.title: Spine e prese per usi domestici e similari – Parte 1: Prescrizioni generali
standards.scope: Italian plugs and socket-outlets, including the standard sheets of the 10 A and 16 A configurations; not reviewed
Former Italian standard, replaced by CEI 23-50

variants.name: CEI 23-50 10 A plug
variants.keying: None: symmetric, line and neutral can be on either outer pin.
mechanicalNotes: Pins 4 mm in diameter; outer pins 19 mm apart, earth pin in the middle.

variants.name: CEI 23-50 10 A socket-outlet
mechanicalNotes: Line and neutral holes about 4.5 mm in diameter, 19 mm apart (collection site); shutters are compulsory on current socket-outlets.

variants.name: CEI 23-50 16 A plug
mechanicalNotes: Pins 5 mm in diameter; outer pins 26 mm apart, earth pin in the middle.

variants.name: CEI 23-50 16 A socket-outlet
mechanicalNotes: Holes about 5.1 mm in diameter, 26 mm apart (collection site).

variants.name: CEI 23-50 bipasso socket-outlet (10 A and 16 A)
variants.keying: None: symmetric. Figure-8 shaped line and neutral holes take both pin spacings.
mechanicalNotes: Central round earth hole between two figure-8 holes.
